editPicking: Suite passed and dimensions settled, but async helper did not establish a valid unbounded predicate wait; superseded for that discriminator
observerProblem: A native capture-listener microtask executed before the actual target click listener; moved the after-click observer to a later target listener.
waitProblem: Playwright 1.60 checks the immediate predicate return for truthiness. An async predicate returns a truthy Promise even when it resolves false. The original presented-state helper could therefore falsely pass.
fix: Separate two-frame presentation boundary from synchronous wait_for_function predicate; timeout=0 for both app-state probes. No sleeps or timeout retries.
